An installer. Open the unpacked AmiFM drawer and double-click **Install_AmiFM**: it asks where the AmiFM drawer should go (default `SYS:Tools`), copies AmiFM, its icon, the README and the licence there. Run it again to update; your settings are kept. AmiFM still runs straight from the unpacked drawer too.

Otherwise AmiFM is the same as [1.2.1](https://github.com/lainejones/AmiFM/releases/tag/v1.2.1).

Use the **.lha**: it keeps the executable bit, which a .zip can't store (see the README). The installer sets it on the copy it installs.

Tested on an A4000 (AmigaOS 3.2): the installer made the drawer and copied everything there.
